info.title: Skyhaul fleet API
info.description: REST contract of the fleet API (services/api), and the Socket.IO event payloads it pushes. Design: docs/architecture/m2-design.md. The backend implements to this file and the UI generates types from it. Every operation needs a bearer JWT unless it has security: []. x-permission names the permission the server checks. Skyhaul serves a single organization. Lists use keyset pagination: ?limit= and an opaque ?cursor=, answered as {items, next_cursor}.

post.summary: Exchange email and password for an access token

patch.summary: Change a user's role or active flag

get.summary: List drones with their latest state
One drone with its latest state

delete.summary: Soft-delete a drone (its id is never reused)

get.summary: Commands sent to a drone, newest first

post.summary: Send a command. 202 means broker-confirmed; the reply arrives as command.updated.

202.description: Accepted and broker-confirmed (status SENT), or an Idempotency-Key replay

post.summary: Plan a mission, and with start=true launch it

201.description: Created (DISPATCHING when start=true, else PLANNED), or an Idempotency-Key replay

post.summary: Abort a DISPATCHING or ACTIVE mission; ABORTED once the drone reports its final status

get.summary: Database, Redis and command publisher are reachable

bearerAuth.description: HS256, iss=skyhaul-api, aud=skyhaul, 15 min. Claims identify the user; the role is read from the database on every request.

RequestId.description: The request id used in logs.

OpenQuery.name: open
OpenQuery.description: true: only alerts not cleared; false: only cleared ones.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Scoped to the user. A replay with the same key returns the original resource and publishes nothing.

RequestIdHeader.name: X-Request-ID
RequestIdHeader.description: Accepted if it is a UUID, otherwise replaced by a generated one. Echoed in the response and in every log line.

BadRequest.description: Malformed request (bad JSON, bad query parameter, bad cursor).

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or expired token, or an inactive user.

Conflict.description: Live mission exists, drone id taken, or illegal state transition.

ServiceUnavailable.description: command_not_sent: the broker did not confirm the publish, or the publisher queue is full.

DroneId.description: Globally unique drone id. One safe routing-key word.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp. Drone-clock fields (ts) keep the wire form with milliseconds and a Z suffix.

Cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor. Clients must not parse or build it.

DirectCommandType.description: Command types accepted by POST /drones/{drone_id}/commands. START_MISSION goes only through /missions, so the missions table stays the source of truth.

FleetAlertCode.description: The contracts AlertCode plus LINK_LOST, which the backend derives because a drone cannot report its own silence.

CommandStatus.description: PENDING: stored, not yet confirmed by the broker. SENT: broker-confirmed. ACKED/NACKED: the drone replied. TIMED_OUT: no reply within the command timeout (a later reply still wins and sets late=true). FAILED: never reached the broker.

MissionLifecycleState.description: Backend mission state, a superset of the drone's MISSION_STATUS states. COMPLETED, ABORTED, FAILED and CANCELLED are terminal.

Error.description: The one error shape for every non-2xx response (same as the simulator control API).

error.description: Stable machine-readable code, e.g. not_found, validation_failed, mission_live, command_not_sent.

detail.description: Human-readable text. Never echoes headers, tokens or input values.

fields.description: Validation failures by field path (e.g. payload.altitude_m). Messages only, never input values.

access_token.description: HS256 JWT, valid for expires_in seconds. No refresh token in M2.

DroneLiveState.description: Latest known state from Redis. Fields are null until the matching telemetry has arrived.

DroneCreate.description: Register a drone. 409 drone_id_taken if the id is registered, including soft-deleted drones (ids are never reused).

TelemetryType.description: Stored telemetry types. HEARTBEAT is not stored; ACK and NACK update commands.

payload.description: The message payload as defined in contracts/schemas/v1/telemetry (TS types in @skyhaul/contracts).
The command payload as defined in contracts/schemas/v1/commands. Validated by the contracts Codec; failures are 422 with field paths.

start.description: Launch at once: ARM (if the drone is LANDED) and START_MISSION are pipelined without waiting.

id.description: Sent to the drone as mission_id.

commands.description: Commands this request published, in send order. Empty when nothing was sent.

SocketAuth.description: Socket.IO connect auth payload for namespace /fleet. The server joins rooms itself; clients send no events in M2.

token.description: The access token. Sent in the Socket.IO auth payload, never in the query string.

SocketConnectError.description: Payload of connect_error, and of the disconnect reason when the expiry sweep closes a session.

DroneStateEvent.description: Socket.IO event drone.state: at most once per drone per ingestor flush.

CommandUpdatedEvent.description: Socket.IO event command.updated. Sent to the dispatcher and admin rooms only.

UserPage.description: One page of User items. Pass next_cursor back as ?cursor= for the next page; null means this is the last page.

DronePage.description: One page of Drone items. Pass next_cursor back as ?cursor= for the next page; null means this is the last page.
